        SELECT [t2].[Id], [t2].[AccessFailedCount], [t2].[AuthenticationSource], [t2].[ConcurrencyStamp], [t2].[CreationTime], [t2].[CreatorUserId], [t2].[DeleterUserId], [t2].[DeletionTime], [t2].[EmailAddress], [t2].[EmailConfirmationCode], [t2].[IsActive], [t2].[IsDeleted], [t2].[IsEmailConfirmed], [t2].[IsLockoutEnabled], [t2].[IsPhoneNumberConfirmed], [t2].[IsTwoFactorEnabled], [t2].[LastModificationTime], [t2].[LastModifierUserId], [t2].[LockoutEndDateUtc], [t2].[Name], [t2].[NormalizedEmailAddress], [t2].[NormalizedUserName], [t2].[Password], [t2].[PasswordResetCode], [t2].[PhoneNumber], [t2].[SecurityStamp], [t2].[Surname], [t2].[TenantId], [t2].[UserName], 1 AS [c], [a0].[UserId], ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY [a0].[UserId] ORDER BY [a0].[Id], [t2].[Id]) AS [row]
        FROM [AppOrders] AS [a0]
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT [a1].[Id], [a1].[AccessFailedCount], [a1].[AuthenticationSource], [a1].[ConcurrencyStamp], [a1].[CreationTime], [a1].[CreatorUserId], [a1].[DeleterUserId], [a1].[DeletionTime], [a1].[EmailAddress], [a1].[EmailConfirmationCode], [a1].[IsActive], [a1].[IsDeleted], [a1].[IsEmailConfirmed], [a1].[IsLockoutEnabled], [a1].[IsPhoneNumberConfirmed], [a1].[IsTwoFactorEnabled], [a1].[LastModificationTime], [a1].[LastModifierUserId], [a1].[LockoutEndDateUtc], [a1].[Name], [a1].[NormalizedEmailAddress], [a1].[NormalizedUserName], [a1].[Password], [a1].[PasswordResetCode], [a1].[PhoneNumber], [a1].[SecurityStamp], [a1].[Surname], [a1].[TenantId], [a1].[UserName]

        WHERE [a0].[CreationTime] >= @__startDate_0 AND [a0].[CreationTime] < @__endDate_1
    ) AS [t0]
    WHERE [t0].[row] <= 1
) AS [t1] ON [t].[UserId] = [t1].[UserId]
